verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes run arbitrary commands and untrusted code inside containers built from custom images with any dependency, so multiple language runtimes are possible. The documented results are only process output from exec and logs; the JS/Go SDKs are client libraries, not evidence of runtimes inside the sandbox. missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-language runtime support (e.g., a JavaScript runtime example inside a sandbox), rich result types (structured outputs, charts/images, display data) beyond process output, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can execute code in multiple language runtimes (Python, JavaScript, and more) and get rich results back
